item.title: Butter Chicken Curry
item.description: Marinade 1 cup full-fat yogurt (240g) 1 Tbsp garam masala (15g) 1 Tbsp kosher salt (15g) 1.5 lbs boneless, skinless chicken thighs (680g) Curry Sauce 2 Tbsp vegetable oil (30g) 1 yellow onion, diced 2-inch knob of ginger, finely diced 6 cloves of garlic, sliced Salt and pepper to taste 2 tsp paprika (8g) 2 tsp ground cumin (9g) 1 Tbsp garam masala (14g) 1.5 tsp turmeric powder (6g) 14 oz crushed tomatoes 2/3 cup water (160ml) 1 cup heavy cream (240ml) 2 Tbsp unsalted butter (28g) Steamed rice Fresh cilantro Instructions In a medium bowl, whisk together the yogurt, garam masala, and kosher salt until combined.
